photos.c: Above: "Out of Africa". A couple of miles into the National Junior Cross Country Championships at Parliament Hill and Belgrave's Kaessa Tadesse leads Coventry Godiva's Stefan White (186), the eventual winner , Blackheath's Tim Dickinson (behind), who ended up 4th, and 'Southern' winner Spencer Barden (242) of GEC Avionics, 3rd.
Halfway. Tim Dickinson (Blackheath) and Kaessa Tadesse run shoulder to shoulder with Spencer Barden (GEC Avionics) and Stefan White (Coventry Godiva) right on their tails.

Front page: Kasse Tadesse leads the field into the back stretch mid-way through the 10,000 metres in the European Clubs Championship at the U.T.E stadium, Budapest. Biding his time at the Belgravian's shoulder is the eventual winner, Morocco's Brahim Boutayeb, racing for Club Larios, Spain. Kasse's time of 29:42.93 was a Junior Club Record!

Above: Some of the 1993/94 cross country gang at the Epsom Downs Surrey League fixture. From left to right, standing: Leo Coy, John Wilson, Kasse Tadesse, Toby Earle, Marcello Bizio, Rob Milner, Stuart Booth, Roger Alsop, John Booth, Cross Country Captain Graham Adams, ?, Charlie Dickinson, Colin Pearson, Steve Willimont, Trevor Williams, Mike Webb, Larry McLean, ?, Marlon Anderson, Martin Readhead, Rex Bale, Jim Estall, Phil Carstairs, Trevor Santer, Owain Lewes. Kneeling: Mark Padfield, Don Anderson, Martin Lake, Marco Mazzotta, Paul Knight, Paul Price, Stephen Whorlow, Adam Cox, ?, Nigel Whorlow.
